title: WeRide Teams Up With GreenMobility To Launch Denmark Robotaxis

WeRide Inc. shares rose Monday after the autonomous-driving company partnered with GreenMobility to pursue commercial shared-mobility services in Denmark.

Denmark Robotaxi Launch Targeted For 2027

The companies aim to launch public service in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. Riders will be able to request trips using WeRide's GXR, an EU-compliant Level 4 fully autonomous vehicle.

The partnership combines WeRide's autonomous-driving technology with GreenMobility's local fleet-management and shared-mobility expertise.

The companies said they would be the first to pursue a commercial autonomous-mobility deployment in Denmark.

Regulatory Collaboration And European Expansion

The project will be developed with public-sector involvement and in coordination with the Danish Road Directorate and Danish Road Traffic Authority.

All testing and deployment will comply with Danish and European Union regulations.

Denmark becomes WeRide's sixth European market and its first in the Nordic region, following recent expansion into Spain and Slovakia.

The rollout supports WeRide's asset-light expansion model, which relies on partnerships with local mobility operators and fleet owners.

"This partnership marks WeRide's first entry into the Nordic region and another important milestone in our European expansion," founder and CEO Tony Han said.

WeRide operates autonomous-driving products in more than 40 cities across 12 countries and has a Level 4 fleet of more than 3,000 vehicles. GreenMobility operates more than 1,500 electric vehicles in the Nordic region.

两家公司表示，他们将成为第一家在丹麦进行商业自动驾驶部署的公司。

监管合作和欧洲扩张

该项目将在公共部门的参与下并与丹麦道路局和丹麦道路交通管理局协调开发。

所有测试和部署都将遵守丹麦和欧盟的法规。

继最近扩展到西班牙和斯洛伐克之后，丹麦成为文远知行在欧洲的第六个市场，也是其在北欧地区的第一个市场。

此次推出支持文远知行的轻资产扩张模式，该模式依赖于与当地出行运营商和车队所有者的合作。

“此次合作标志着文远知行首次进入北欧地区，也是我们欧洲扩张的又一个重要里程碑，”文远知行创始人兼首席执行官韩旭表示。

文远知行文远知行在12个国家的40多个城市运营自动驾驶产品，拥有超过3000辆的4级车队。 GreenMobility 在北欧地区运营着 1,500 多辆电动汽车。
